name: API Orchestrator - Integration Samples
description: Container module for optional sample integrations (Magento, Shopify, JSONPlaceholder); enable the individual sample submodules.
project_description: API Orchestrator - Integration Samples is a lightweight container module for the bundled sample integrations. It carries no configuration itself; enable one of the individual sample submodules (JSONPlaceholder, Shopify, Magento) which depend on it to install ready-to-run API service and endpoint config entities. Requires api_orchestrator. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
